<!-- ocr-summary -->
🔍 **OpenCodeReview** found **1** issue(s) in this PR.

## Failed

- Workflow: `test`, step `pr-size`

`yarn.lock` was dropped from the list of lockfiles excluded from the reviewable-line count.

## Reproduced

Ran `bash /tmp/gh-aw/agent/ci/head/bin/pr-size.test.sh`: `passed=45 failed=2`.

## Suggested fix

In `bin/pr-size`, restore `yarn.lock` to the list of excluded lockfiles.

<!-- gh-aw-workflow-call-id: PatrickPriestley/agent-workflow/ci-diagnose -->

**Cause**: `bin/pr-size` line 61: this PR's commit removed `yarn.lock` from the lockfile exclude loop.

**Fix**: `bin/pr-size` — added `yarn.lock` back to the exclude loop.

**Proved**: `bash bin/pr-size.test.sh` now reports `passed=47 failed=0`.

Pushed the fix. Please re-run `test`.

<!-- gh-aw-workflow-call-id: PatrickPriestley/agent-workflow/ci-fix -->

| Lockfiles ... never count as reviewable lines | **Failed on this PR's head**, held on `main` (25 cases) |

AssertionError: lockfiles counted: {'Cargo.lock': 1, 'yarn.lock': 1}

So this is **a real bug introduced by this PR**: the diff removes `yarn.lock` from the excluded-lockfiles loop.
